avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 6 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Leavitt Lake (9,600 ft) 7 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Leavitt Lake
evidence.detail: left June 14; earlier seasons: July 30 (2023), June 21 (2024), June 17 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Leavitt Lake (9,600 ft) and Sonora Pass Bridge (8,750 ft).

evidence.name: Leavitt Lake
evidence.detail: 44.6 in on May 5; earlier seasons: 118.4 in (2023), 61.3 in (2024), 53.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Sonora Pass Bridge
evidence.detail: 11.4 in on April 13; earlier seasons: 58.0 in (2023), 24.9 in (2024), 23.5 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 28 and July 16, carried from the melt-out date at Leavitt Lake (9,600 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Leavitt Lake
evidence.detail: melted out June 14, 413 ft below the pass; points to May 28 to July 16
